title: Ban bets on unfinished clinical trials
title_zh: 赌注押注未完成的临床试验
abstract: In July, the prediction market platform Kalshi and data company AppliedXL began a pilot market listing binary, yes-or-no contracts on whether named late-stage clinical trials meet their preregistered primary end points. Kalshi lists contracts only after trial enrollment closes, reasoning that a visible price—in effect the market’s odds that the trial succeeds—could sway recruitment. But closing enrollment does not end an experiment. Traders can buy and sell contracts while trial participants still attend visits, staff still measure outcomes, and interim results remain confidential. The line belongs at the end of the experiment, not of enrollment: No public contract on a trial’s efficacy or safety result should trade while the trial is ongoing and before the result is public.
abstract_zh: 2023年7月，预测市场平台Kalshi与数据公司AppliedXL启动了一个试点市场，上市关于是否命名的晚期临床试验能否达到其预注册的主要终点的二元是/否合约。Kalshi仅在试验招募结束后才上市合约，理由是可见的价格——实际上是市场对试验成功的赔率——可能会影响招募。然而，招募结束并不意味着实验结束。交易者可以在试验参与者仍在就诊、工作人员仍在测量结果、以及中期结果仍保密的情况下买卖合约。真正的界限应在实验结束时，而非招募结束时：在试验进行期间以及结果公开前，不应有任何公开合约交易关于试验的疗效或安全性结果。
